লক্ষ কর, $\frac{a^n}{a^n} = a^{n-n} = a^0$

কিন্তু $\frac{a^n}{a^n} = \frac{a \times a \times a \times \dots \times a \quad (n \text{ সংখ্যক})}{a \times a \times a \times \dots \times a \quad (n \text{ সংখ্যক})} = 1$

$\therefore a^0 = 1$

আর $\frac{1}{a^n} = \frac{a^0}{a^n} = a^{0-n} = a^{-n}$

উদাহরণ ১. মান নির্ণয় কর: ক) $\frac{5^2}{5^3}$ খ) $\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^5 \times \left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^{-5}$

সমাধান:

ক) $\frac{5^2}{5^3} = 5^{2-3} = 5^{-1} = \frac{1}{5^1} = \frac{1}{5}$

খ) $\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^5 \times \left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^{-5} = \left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^{5-5} = \left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^0 = 1$

উদাহরণ ২. সরল কর: ক) $\frac{5^4 \times 8 \times 16}{2^5 \times 125}$ খ) $\frac{3 \cdot 2^n - 4 \cdot 2^{n-2}}{2^n - 2^{n-1}}$

সমাধান:

ক) $\frac{5^4 \times 8 \times 16}{2^5 \times 125} = \frac{5^4 \times 2^3 \times 2^4}{2^5 \times 5^3} = \frac{5^4 \times 2^{3+4}}{5^3 \times 2^5} = \frac{5^4}{5^3} \times \frac{2^7}{2^5}$

$= 5^{4-3} \times 2^{7-5} = 5^1 \times 2^2 = 5 \times 4 = 20$

খ) $\frac{3 \cdot 2^n - 4 \cdot 2^{n-2}}{2^n - 2^{n-1}} = \frac{3 \cdot 2^n - 2^2 \cdot 2^{n-2}}{2^n - 2^n \cdot 2^{-1}} = \frac{3 \cdot 2^n - 2^{2+n-2}}{2^n - 2^n \cdot \frac{1}{2}}$

$= \frac{3 \cdot 2^n - 2^n}{(1 - \frac{1}{2}) \cdot 2^n} = \frac{(3-1) \cdot 2^n}{\frac{1}{2} \cdot 2^n} = \frac{2 \cdot 2^n}{\frac{1}{2} \cdot 2^n} = 2 \cdot 2 = 4$

উদাহরণ ৩. দেখাও যে, $(a^p)^{q-r} \cdot (a^q)^{r-p} \cdot (a^r)^{p-q} = 1$

সমাধান: $(a^p)^{q-r} \cdot (a^q)^{r-p} \cdot (a^r)^{p-q} = a^{p(q-r)} \cdot a^{q(r-p)} \cdot a^{r(p-q)} \quad [\because (a^m)^n = a^{mn}]$

$= a^{pq-pr} \cdot a^{qr-qp} \cdot a^{pr-qr} = a^{pq-pr+qr-qp+pr-qr} = a^0 = 1$

কাজ: খালি ঘর পূরণ কর:
ক) $3 \times 3 \times 3 \times 3 = 3^{\square}$ খ) $5^{\square} \times 5^3 = 5^5$ গ) $a^2 \times a^{\square} = a^{-3}$
ঘ) $(-5)^0 = \square$ ঙ) $\frac{1}{4^{\square}} = 1$
